title: DHS Krishnagiri Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 69 Driver, Account Assistant and Other Posts
description: District Health Society Krishnagiri (DHS Krishnagiri) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 69 dispensers, dentists, MLHPs, drivers, and Other Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in 10th Pass, 08th, Any Degree, B. Pharm, B.Sc Nursing, BDS, GNM, 12th, M.Sc, MBBS, Post Graduation can grab this chance and apply for the DHS Krishnagiri Notification 2026 . Here, we provide details on the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education requirements, application fee...
